work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: The act thanks Leopold I of the Belgians for confirming Count Auguste de Liedekerke as his envoy and commends the Catholic subjects to him. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF6615; own dating clause LF6654–6655 reads: Datum Roinae apud s. Petrum die g iulii 1831, pontif..Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF6711 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Whole native leaf56 image (archive.org, sha256 2de301726ef98d0846bf3df471ffeaf93126bdd0f2d46400ba5f2c5bacba5757) prints die 9 iulii 1831 where the OCR reads g; the OCR text is unchanged. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
